title: Native-owner maximum research level is not enforced for five productivity technologies

source_observation.environment: Exact public 3.2.9 archive SHA-256 0E833FCDDA3017641CA99D0EBD2FA226938A1CEE91D2EBB4007E94B29787AE20 reproduced on locally installed Factorio 2.1.14; exact supported 2.1.13 qualification remains mandatory.
source_observation.fact: A finite data-stage TechnologyPrototype.max_level clamps an already-completed infinite technology level before MIR's configuration-change handler can preserve it. The earlier fixture proved only final prototype assignment, not force/save/research behavior.

reproducer.expected: Completed level 8 remains completed when the absolute cap is lowered to 5; invalid current and queued research are removed.
reproducer.observed: Public 3.2.9 changed the completed level from 8 to 5 before runtime recovery.

implementation: Keep managed prototypes infinite on script-capable targets; publish a compiler-owned maximum-level policy; enforce finite absolute caps at runtime without unresearching completed levels; remove invalid current/queued levels; restore MIR-disabled technologies when caps rise or return to zero; refuse and diagnose late finite prototype conflicts.
